name: anthropic_to_gemini_strict_loss
_comment: Anthropic tools strict:true is a known loss toward Gemini: strict refuses pre-I/O, never a silent drop.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.gem]
dialect = "gemini"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "gem-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-gem"
provider = "gem"
model = "gemini-2.0-flash"
